result.title: Effectiveness of progressive and resisted and non-progressive or non-resisted exercise in rotator cuff related shoulder pain: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
result.abstractText:
Objective

Synthesize evidence regarding effectiveness of progressive and resisted or non-progressive and non-resisted exercise compared with placebo or no treatment, in rotator cuff related pain.

Data sources

English articles, searched in Cochrane CENTRAL, MEDLINE, EMBASE and CINAHL d
